body:
This is called even if the rotation already started, which leads to a wrong undo/redo history. Steps to reproduce:
1. make sure you are in select mode
2. select object
3. hold control and drag object
4. undo: the rotation is not reset correctly when undoing

As far as I understand, this is why the undo/redo history has a wrong value for undoing:
- The rotation is started initially within `_sinput()` (to be exact: line 2076)
- Then after moving the mouse more than the threshold, it is started again here in line 2242. At this point the object is already rotated a bit, so calling `_compute_edit()` again will store the already rotated transform as the "initial" transform, overriding the correct one
- When the transform is finished, the undo/redo is registered with the wrong initial transform value
Ah I see now, when the rotation is initiated on the select objected.
